staging_pool_note: Path is relative to the shared kernel-staging export of the project artifact store; the mount root differs per build host.
note: amd64 DEFAULT, installer and rescue kernel under the unified 7.3 policy (2026-10-05, ported 2026-10-11 to v7.3-rc7; r2 rebuild 2026-10-12). AER: Lukas Wunner's 79c168e2aa95 'PCI/AER: Skip error recovery on false alarms' is in v7.3-rc7 base (replaces the rc6-4 plain-revert 9010), and a narrow Apple SEP ANFE quirk 9011 (DECLARE_PCI_FIXUP_EARLY(APPLE, 0x1802, quirk_no_aer_anfe)) leaves the Apple T2 Secure Enclave's ANFE bit masked. Also carried: 9013 PCI/DPC enumeration guard (dev->aer_cap), 9101 integrity T2 cert-skip info, 9102 btbcm BCM4364B3 + T2 ROM firmware info. 9012 (nouveau gcx_ready NULL gsp->rm fix) is dropped because upstream 4d0e27041185 is already in v7.3-rc7. r2 adds 2010: it restores the upstream vga_default_device boot-GPU guard that the t2linux 2009 patch dropped, scoped to T2 via apple_t2_present() (Apple T2 bridge 106b:1801). Without it a Mac whose ACPI lists APP000B but whose gmux is non-functional (e.g. Macmini5,1) deferred i915 forever: no /dev/dri, greetd skipped, headless with no error. The kernel RELEASE stays 7.3.0-rc7-t2-ncz (KVER pin stable across r1/r2); the package REVISION is 7.3.0-rc7-2 so apt/pins can tell r2 from the first rc7 build (<version>-1). The rEFInd hook's is_stable_class already accepts *-t2-ncz* so the rescue/stable classification is unchanged. Replaced by the 7.3.0 final build later.

source.t2_cyclops_note: Patch 2010 restores the upstream boot-GPU guard in vga_switcheroo_client_probe_defer() (pdev != vga_default_device()) and scopes the 2009 relaxation to T2 (apple_t2_present() = pci_get_device(PCI_VENDOR_ID_APPLE, 0x1801, NULL)). Built and verified: the vmlinux disassembly of vga_switcheroo_client_probe_defer calls both vga_default_device and pci_get_device; the staged source tree carries the guard. Hardware-proven on a Macmini5,1 test machine: i915 binds natively, /dev/dri/card0 appears, greetd starts and renders the greeter with NO ncz-vsfix workaround loaded.

identity.config_reference: amd64-kernel-t2 builds its own config from templates/default-config-debian + the series' CONFIG_* additions; reference is the FINAL .config (kernel_config_7.3.0-rc7-t2-ncz) shipped in the staging pool. The r2 config is byte-identical to the first rc7 build (config sha e88c4505...), as expected: 2010 is a source change with no Kconfig effect.

hardware_note: Hardware-validated 2026-10-12 (this r2 build). Macmini5,1 test machine (ACPI APP000B present, non-functional gmux): the r2 kernel binds i915 natively with the ncz-vsfix workaround DISABLED — /dev/dri/card0, all 7 connectors, greetd active (ExecCondition status=0), greeter screenshot captured; the same host on the r1 release kernel (workaround disabled) reproduced the defect: i915 unbound, no /dev/dri, greetd exec-condition FAILURE, devices_deferred 0000:00:02.0 with a blank reason. MacBookPro16,1 T2 Macs: gmux/t2gmux behaviour unchanged, 04:00.2 ANFE mask 0x6000 (9011 active), suspend/resume PASS, 20-min soak PASS. GU502LV laptop / OmniDesk desktop (non-Apple): unaffected. Full evidence in the staged pool's STATIC-GATE.txt/KVM-GATE.log.
